user_inputs.cohort_description: Prior heart failure diagnosis, end-stage renal disease

conversation_history.content: Which event should serve as the index event: first diagnosis of heart failure, first diagnosis of end-stage renal disease, first documentation of both conditions together, initiation of dialysis, kidney transplant, or another event? Please specify whether the index should be the 'first', 'any', or 'most recent' occurrence.

Which clinical event should serve as the index event: any diagnosis of heart failure, any diagnosis of end-stage renal disease, any documentation of both conditions on the same date, any initiation of dialysis, any kidney transplant, or another event? (You previously indicated 'any' for occurrence — I will use 'any occurrence' once you pick the event.)
both conditions on the same date,
Do you want any demographic restrictions for the cohort? Specifically, should we limit by age (for example adults aged 18 and older, or a specific age range) or by sex (male, female, or any)?
Do you require a minimum continuous observation period before the index date (for example, 365 days)? If yes, please specify the number of days (e.g., 365). If no requirement, reply 'none'.

Do you want to exclude patients with prior kidney transplant, ongoing dialysis treatment, prior heart transplant, active metastatic cancer or other malignancy, receipt of palliative/hospice care, or any other specific conditions or treatments? If no exclusions, reply 'none'.
✅ **Clarification complete!** I have all the information needed to define your cohort.

cohort_definition.index_event: First date on which both a heart failure diagnosis and an end-stage renal disease diagnosis are recorded on the same date (use the first date on which both appear together).
inclusion_criteria: History of heart failure: a diagnosis of heart failure recorded any time prior to or on the index date.
End-stage renal disease: a diagnosis of end-stage renal disease recorded any time prior to or on the index date.
cohort_definition.observation_window: No minimum prior observation required. Capture medical history any time before the index date. Follow-up after index: until end of enrollment (end of continuous observation) or death.
cohort_definition.cohort_exit: End of continuous observation (end of enrollment) or death.
